title: Mobile Shell
tagline: A native iOS and Android app that runs your apps, with scanner, push and biometrics.
summary: A generic native shell for iOS and Android built for the SAP mobile stack: the regular abap2UI5 frontend runs in a WebView, and a small JavaScript bridge offers device features - the barcode scanner (z2ui5.cc.NativeBridgeScan), push notifications and a biometric confirmation. Every screen still comes from the ABAP class. A proof of concept without releases: onboarding through the SAP BTP SDK and push need SAP, Google and Apple accounts.
useWhen: Use when the apps have to run in a native iOS or Android shell with the device's barcode scanner, push notifications or biometrics; a proof of concept, built with Xcode or Android Studio, nothing to install in ABAP.
features: Android (WebView, ZXing scan) and iOS (WKWebView, VisionKit scan) shells
QR onboarding, biometric app lock, managed configuration from device management
Push via FCM and APNs, with a Mobile Services push client for ABAP Cloud
z2ui5.cc.NativeBridgeScan in the framework scans through the bridge and stays a placeholder in a browser
Online only by design: every event is a server roundtrip
requirements: abap2UI5 with z2ui5.cc.NativeBridgeScan for the scanner
Android Studio or Xcode (XcodeGen) to build the shells
For onboarding and push: SAP Mobile Services, a Firebase project and an APNs key

notes: abap/src is the sample app, installable with abapGit; the shells are built from android/ and ios/
Status and open work: PLAN.md and docs/NEXT_STEPS.md in the repository
